---
name: 💡 Feature or Improvement Proposal
about: Propose a new capability, radio feature, or community enhancement
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ['atrifan']
---

### 1. Proposal Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

### 2. User Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve for listeners, DJs, or developers?

### 3. Proposed Implementation Details
- Architecture or API design thoughts
- Does this impact UI, backend, or bots?
- Any new external services or zero-cost constraints?

### 4. Zero-Cost & Safety Compliance
- [ ] Confirmed $0 cloud footprint impact.
- [ ] Confirmed TDD unit/integration tests and Stryker mutation testing can be implemented.
